roles.background: zeta/L-functions, explicit formulae, zero-free regions, PNT error terms
roles.finding: Bellotti's unconditional KV-scale PNT estimate supplies |psi(x)-x|/x << exp(-d (log x)^(3/5)(loglog x)^(-1/5)); the floor correction is asymptotically absorbable.
roles.challenge: The candidate must not use zero-density as a pointwise RH bridge; only the unconditional PNT consequence is used.

roles.background: Laguerre polynomials, uniform asymptotics, coefficient estimates
roles.finding: The coefficient identity gives |L_{n-1}^{(1)}(u)|<=n exp(2sqrt(nu)); the derivative identity gives the n^2 companion bound. n=1 is separately valid.
roles.challenge: The bounds are deliberately crude and provide no cutoff optimality.

roles.background: counterexample-first analysis, quantifier stress tests, hostile asymptotics
roles.finding: The logarithmic-zero-free comparator loses the exponent race under the same crude Laguerre envelope, while KV decay wins after a moving cutoff.
roles.challenge: The negative result is method-family-specific and cannot be generalized to the 2026 zero-free theorem itself.

roles.background: proof DAGs, quantifier order, dependency and verifier audits
roles.finding: The proof order is coherent: exact Abel identity -> source bound -> kernel/derivative envelopes -> monotone ratio -> boundary/integral. Constants are existential and uniform in n after C0 is fixed.
roles.challenge: No formal verifier or proof assistant is bound; no PROOF_CHECKED authority.

roles.background: analytic-number-theory literature mapping, theorem normalization, novelty control
roles.finding: The result composes standard Abel summation and Laguerre identities with Bellotti's current PNT theorem.
roles.challenge: No literature-novelty claim is defensible from this bounded search.

roles.background: proof-DAG interfaces, local-to-global synthesis, equivalent-criterion auditing
roles.finding: The tail is negligible only beyond an enormous X_n; the moving prefix and archimedean/Li ledger remain unclosed.
roles.challenge: A polynomial bound on the combined prefix may simply repackage the R3 root-strength obligation.

roles.background: v3 gates, evidence identity, CI/provenance, longitudinal telemetry
roles.finding: Focused current-v3 gate passed at exact branch head 27b9a761... with current framework pin 43897d3..., authorizing shadow materialization. Full application suite remains red and the branch is behind current RAKL_math main.
roles.challenge: Do not treat focused CI as integration assurance, mathematical review, novelty authority, or root promotion.

consensus: Retain candidate as a source-bound route-local mathematical lemma; close RH-ANA-003d locally and open RH-ANA-003e for moving-prefix obligation strength and exact Li gluing.
strongest_objection: The theorem may reduce only a tail that was never the root-hard coordinate; the finite prefix may retain essentially all RH difficulty.
unresolved: strict weakness of any useful prefix certificate relative to RH
